failure_signature: Paper summaries or search failure become consensus or novelty.
control: Use ROUTE_SELECTOR_MIN or FULL and name the unit, evidence and prohibited inference.

failure_signature: Access, permission, evidence, time or evaluation burden remains assumed rather than tested.
control: Run the smallest safe feasibility sprint and record continue, narrow, pivot or stop.

failure_signature: Publication counts, search failure or selective favourable findings are treated as consensus, novelty or exhaustiveness.
control: Verify review type, protocol, search routes, publication-to-study identity, eligibility, appraisal, extraction, synthesis and amendment control.

failure_signature: Conclusions remain bounded by the protocol, corpus and synthesis method.
control: Known-item test, duplicate/version trial and sample screening or extraction.; preserve work-unit provenance and deviations.

failure_signature: Number of favourable publications becomes consensus or universal effectiveness
control: Eligibility or appraisal sensitivity, overlap analysis and incompatible-outcome challenge; retain counter-evidence and rejected stronger wording.

failure_signature: The thesis, evidence package, demonstration, slides or oral account describes a different route, release, result or claim.
control: Trace one finding from search record to publication cluster, underlying study, appraisal, synthesis memo and bounded claim. Preserve a same-release fallback and rehearse the hostile question.
